author: vladthegreat100
body:
Here's a list of bugs for you kids since it seems like the community slack is useless to you devs :)

- No one can write on the forums (https://i.gyazo.com/d8d108b88adb23611eb68ca6af41ceaa.png)
- Stats are broken on the forums (avicus.net/stats)
- All bans have been wiped (even the current bans *cough* stevo *cough*
- Vote, Lottery and Development page are all 404
- May not be a bug but perks of ranks are not told. I like to pay $60 for a name. (https://i.gyazo.com/105f40918841f92b300929c454e66a24.png)
- Recent posts are fucked up and can be used as a forum (https://i.gyazo.com/05f36c48338bcbc5bdccea260939357e.png)
- The drop down thing gets hidden by shit in front of it (https://i.gyazo.com/548d0dd5cf03452dc009781042887dbd.png)

Whenever the first problem gets fixed type the bugs you found on this thread.
There are so many using github will take forever, and you guys don't seem to active on community slack to check out all the bugs being typed there.
I'll update the list when I can :) Any people that are above the rules that have extra powers to punish can edit too.

Have a nice day!
 
Best Regards,
~Vlad :)
